availability_evidence.book_facts: Current read-only game-authored book corroborates Al-Metes basic preparation families and named Alaran regional dishes. No selected row states scribing or a class/race gate.
availability_evidence.historical_limit: Maintained VoA category and current book are corroborating context; frozen per-formula May2013 numeric receipts are unavailable. Page introduction modification label2012-01-04 does not date dynamically returned formulas.

restriction_review.container: Mixing Bowl BagType14 or Oven/Spit BagType15 exactly as source; genuine10slot Mixing Bowl17906 and Oven54256 guarded. Selected mixing formulas use at most3units; selected oven formulas at most8. Six-slot spits naturally cannot fit larger formulas; no slot expansion.
restriction_review.learning: Ordinary experimentable recipes, must_learn0 and learned_by_item_id0. No cap/class/race changes.
restriction_review.returns: Smoker, Skewers and Pot returned on success/failure exactly as source; returned tools salvage0. Consumables use normal component salvage quantities as translation convention, not historical AA proof.
restriction_review.acquisition: Recipe availability does not establish natural ingredient acquisition.
